main_measure.name: mean excess 3-bar return of the top-20% forecast grid bars
main_measure.threshold: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting difference > 0) confirms; mean < 0 with t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: top-group mean excess minus forecast-0 mean excess

decided_by: The top-group mean excess return is above 0 with t >= 2 and the supporting difference is above 0.
reading: The top group is the grid bars with forecast > 0 (and a valid 3-bar return) whose forecast is at or above the 80th percentile of those bars pooled over coins, ties at the cut-off included; the coin's mean 3-bar return is the mean over its non-overlapping grid returns across all windows; the plan's 'fewer than 100 top-group bars' case is reported as not observable.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
